item.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Conservative Value Ensembles
item.description: arXiv:2511.00101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study offline reinforcement learning where the agent must learn a policy from a fixed dataset. We propose conservative value ensembles that penalize out-of-distribution actions and improve policy optimization on D4RL benchmarks.
item.dc:creator: Maria García, Adrian Del Maestro, Wei Zhang

item.title: Reward Shaping for Sparse-Reward Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning
item.description: arXiv:2511.00102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploration under sparse rewards remains difficult for deep reinforcement learning agents. We introduce a reward shaping method based on learned potential functions that accelerates policy learning in Atari and MuJoCo.
item.dc:creator: John Smith, Priya Patel

item.title: Spectral Bounds for Graph Neural Network Expressivity
item.description: arXiv:2511.00103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive spectral bounds on the expressivity of message passing graph neural networks and relate them to the Weisfeiler-Lehman hierarchy.
item.dc:creator: Li Chen, Oskar Novak

item.title: Contamination Detection for Language Model Benchmarks
item.description: arXiv:2511.00106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Benchmark contamination inflates evaluation scores of large language models. We propose a membership inference method to detect test set contamination in pretraining data.
item.dc:creator: Rui Silva, Sara Okafor

item.title: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy for Medical Imaging
item.description: arXiv:2511.00107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study federated learning across hospitals with differential privacy guarantees for medical image segmentation.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Lee

item.title: An Old Paper That Was Replaced
item.description: arXiv:2511.00109v1 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This replacement should be dropped.
item.dc:creator: Someone Else

item.title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Legged Robot Locomotion
item.description: arXiv:2511.00110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combine learned world models with model predictive control to train legged robot locomotion policies with reinforcement learning in under one hour of real-world data.
item.dc:creator: Jorg Muller, Yuki Tanaka

item.title: Scaling Laws for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Training
item.description: arXiv:2511.00112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We fit scaling laws for sparse mixture-of-experts language model pretraining as a function of expert count and compute.
item.dc:creator: David Kim
